verdict.rationale: Box ships a documented first-party Box AI API with its own guide that covers asking questions of files, summarizing them, and extracting metadata, including request handling and input limits. Changelog entries for model updates and a visual agent configurator show the feature is live and maintained, not just announced. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Box AI quality (community evidence does not cover it).

support.subject: As an AI-native team, the storage understands its contents — a first-party AI surface (ask questions of files, summarize, extract) shipped and documented, not just announced
